3.name: Spellfire Burst
3.notes:
When you spend ≥1 Sorcery Point as part of the Magic action or a Bonus Action on your turn, you can trigger one of the following effects (once per turn):

- Bolstering Flames: You or a creature within 30 ft. gains THP = 1d4 + Charisma modifier.
- Radiant Fire: One creature within 30 ft. takes 1d4 Fire or Radiant damage (your choice).

3.name: Spellfire Spells
3.notes:
You always have the following spells prepared at the listed Sorcerer levels:

3rd: Cure Wounds, Guiding Bolt, Lesser Restoration, Scorching Ray
5th: Aura of Vitality, Dispel Magic
7th: Fire Shield, Wall of Fire
9th: Greater Restoration, Flame Strike

6.name: Absorb Spells
6.notes:
You always have Counterspell prepared.
Whenever a target fails the saving throw against your Counterspell, you regain 1d4 Sorcery Points.

14.name: Honed Spellfire
14.notes:
Your Spellfire Burst improves:
- Bolstering Flames: Add your Sorcerer level to the Temporary Hit Points gained.
- Radiant Fire: Damage increases to 1d8.

18.name: Crown of Spellfire
18.notes:
When you use Innate Sorcery, you can infuse it with spellfire. Benefits last while Innate Sorcery is active.
You can do this once per Long Rest, or restore it by spending 5 Sorcery Points.

Burning Life Force: Once per turn when hit by an attack, expend up to Charisma modifier HP dice (min 1). Roll them and reduce the incoming damage by the total rolled.

Flight: You gain a Fly Speed of 60 ft and can hover.

Spell Avoidance: When a spell or magical effect allows a save for half damage, you instead take no damage on a success and half damage on a failure. Disabled if Incapacitated.
